description: List public addresses from an extended PUBLIC key (xpub/ypub/zpub/tpub…): chain (e.g. btc, ltc), kind (p2pkh | p2wpkh | p2sh-p2wpkh | p2tr), branch 0=receive 1=change, start, count ≤ 20. Private keys (xprv etc.) and seed phrases are refused. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: xpub_addresses
title: Derive receive/change addresses from an xpub (dev tool)
